story: Sophie and Mama are in the kitchen. Sophie is wearing a big yellow crown. [emotion:QT/sad] "My crown is broken!" Sophie says. The crown has three pieces. Mama sits on the red chair. Mama and Sophie put the pieces together. Sophie holds the round piece. Mama holds the tall piece. They press the pieces onto the crown. The crown is fixed! [emotion:QT/happy] Papa is in the living room. Sophie runs to Papa. Sophie puts the crown on Papa's head. [emotion:QT/happy] Papa is a happy king!
